summary: Clean on COR. All five modules are thin passthroughs: each wrapper forwards its scalar args verbatim to _call_lib_func, which (for these all-scalar signatures) lowers them directly with no struct/ABI repack path engaged. Every wrapper's signature in signatures.py matches the real SQLite C prototype (return types, arg widths, signed/unsigned), the int32 length params for bind_text/bind_blob/result_text/result_blob/result_error correctly mirror C's `int` and are paired with uint64 *64 variants for >2GB payloads, destructor sentinels (SQLITE_STATIC=0, SQLITE_TRANSIENT=-1) are correct and pass cleanly through the intp param, and docstring arg-order/contract claims match the actual wrapper arities. No wrong-result, edge-case, truncation, or contract-drift defect found.
